The card says the run stopped at epoch 0.48 of 3. The Hub file training_args.bin is a pickle whose declared type includes trl SFTConfig; the pickle was not opened. The released weights are one BF16 file, 999,885,952 parameters. The GitHub README puts Gemma 3 1B in the Group 3 student full-fine-tune baseline, not in the distillation group. The PEFT rank 64 and alpha 128 in that README are for the LoRA runs, not this full fine-tune. No arXiv paper. The card's ~836K train and 181,874 test counts do not match splits_metadata.json.

evaluation_reported.text: The card reports early-stop eval accuracy 80.91 percent on a 2,000-sample subset of the validation split, and holdout test accuracy 0.9670 with macro F1 0.9669 on 181,874 samples.
